blocks.html: The layout configuration to be created.

types.name: zone
types.description: The zone (page) this configuration is for, e.g. "product.details".

types.name: user_id
types.description: The user ID this configuration belongs to. Null for the system default.

types.name: is_system_default
types.description: Whether this is the system default configuration for the zone.

children.name: widgets
children.description: Per-widget placement and visibility preferences, keyed by widget ID.

children.name: section
children.description: Override which section this widget appears in.

children.name: order
children.description: Override the sort order of the widget within its section.
